| If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if forfeit reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Lana Dobreed & Sacrifice (Virtual Block 6)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Lana Dobreed & Sacrifice (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Lana Dobreed & Sacrifice (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]] column.
